1.w: Of David. I give You praise with all of my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.

2.w: I bow down toward the temple of Your holiness, and I give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion, and for Your faithfulness; for You have magnified above all Your name [and] Your word.

3.w: On the day I called out, then You answered me; You embolden me in my soul [with] strength.

4.w: O YHWH, all the kings of the earth will give You thanks when they hear the words of Your mouth.

5.w: And they will sing of the ways of YHWH: For great [is] the glory of YHWH!

6.w: For YHWH [is] on high, and the lowly one He sees, and the haughty He knows from afar.

7.w: When I walk in the midst of distress, You revive me against the anger of my enemies; You stretch out Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.

8.w: May YHWH complete [this] on my behalf! O YHWH, Your loving devotion [is] forever; do not forsake the works of Your hands!
